name: coreutils
notes: GNU coreutils via MSYS2; Windows filesystem and user semantics differ from Unix.
description: GNU File, Shell, and Text utilities

name: readline
notes: UCRT64 development library, not a standalone command. Headers and import libraries are installed in the keg include/lib directories.

name: libyaml
notes: UCRT64 development library; headers/import libraries are installed in the keg include/lib directories.

name: pkg-config
notes: pkgconf implementation, following Homebrew pkg-config compatibility naming.
description: Manage compile and link flags for libraries

name: ffmpeg
description: Play, record, convert, and stream audio and video

name: git
notes: MinGit, the official minimal Git for Windows distribution; GUI tools are omitted.

name: yarn
notes: Yarn Classic, matching the standalone Homebrew yarn package.

name: chromedriver
notes: Chrome browser is not installed automatically; driver/browser major versions must match.

name: python3
notes: Official full CPython NuGet tools distribution, not the restricted embeddable ZIP.

name: youtube-dl
notes: Actual youtube-dl, not yt-dlp. Upstream latest stable is old; modern site compatibility is not guaranteed.

name: redis
notes: Community MSYS2-based Redis Windows port; not an official Redis Windows build. No service is registered or started.

name: heroku
notes: Official standalone CLI with bundled Node.js. Login/deployment are never run during installation.

name: firefox
notes: Mozilla MSIX payload extracted as a portable application. No Store registration, shortcuts, default-browser changes or GUI launch.

name: awscli
notes: Official AWS CLI v2 MSI read as data only. No installer actions or machine-wide installation.

name: maven
notes: Includes a pinned Eclipse Temurin JDK 21 resource; JAVA_HOME is scoped to Maven wrappers.

name: rbenv
notes: Experimental MSYS2 shell integration. Does not promise native Windows Ruby builds, include ruby-build, or modify shell profiles.
